macros.name: cardbackstyle
macros.doc: The style of the back of the card can be conveniently selected with the \cardbackstyle{style} command, where style can either be empty or plain.

macros.name: cardfrontfoot
macros.doc: The headings style allows you to set a running footer with the \cardfrontfoot{text} command, as well as set a header for each card with an optional argument to the flashcard environment.

macros.name: cardfrontstyle
macros.doc: The style of the front of the card can be conveniently selected with the \cardfrontstyle{style} command, where style can be one of empty, plain, or headings.

macros.name: evenoffset
macros.doc: If the array of cards is not centered left-to-right on the paper, you should set \oddoffset to the left margin of the front and \evenoffset to the right margin of the front.

macros.name: oddoffset
macros.doc: If the array of cards is not centered left-to-right on the paper, you should set \oddoffset to the left margin of the front and \evenoffset to the right margin of the front.

envs.name: flashcard
envs.doc: The FlashCards class provideds the environment flashcard for specifying the contents of each flash card.
